title: Beaver Connector - No More Fiddly Cable Lugs
descriptionHtml:
Get rid of cable hassle once and for all

Have you been in the middle of a project and lacked the right tool
Looked for cable lugs that don't exist
Tried to crimp with pliers that don't work

Small electrical jobs should be simple. Still, they often become needlessly complicated and time-consuming.

The easiest way to connect cables

With these quick connectors you connect cables without soldering and without special tools.

Take the cable
Insert it into the connector
Press down the lock
Hear the click

Done.

Perfect for LED lighting, low voltage and small electrical projects at home.

Why more people choose this solution

Tool-free installation
Fast and easy to use
Stable and secure connection
Transparent design so you can see the cable is seated correctly
Can be opened and reused
Fits low-voltage cables such as 12V and 24V

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
